_comment: CCV-L23 across a connection (OA 481-483; TI-554..556; tools/lint-rtl.py, check_connections): the back edges that stood when the check was made, one per (parent, instance, child input). net_stage is the parent net feeding the input, port_stage its own tag (null: an inner helper with no register, whose ports carry none), deficit the most stages any of its outputs is tagged earlier than the child's own latency allows, kind whether some path through the child is combinational. Their owner (OI for rtl/ooe) declares each as a cross-module loop in the parent's feedback.json (OA signs) or restructures it, combinational ones first (OA 483), and removes its entry. The list only shrinks: lint refuses an entry not in tools/conn-ratchet-baseline.json, and one it no longer finds.
